Help with a booking

Please include your booking reference, which starts with GP- (for example GP-5B693D) and is shown on the booking in the app.

  • To cancel a booking, open it from the Bookings tab and tap Cancel booking. The refund you will get is shown before you confirm.
  • If you can't use a space you booked (it is locked, occupied, not as described, or you can't reach the host), open the booking and tap Report a problem.
  • For refunds, see our Cancellation & Refund Policy.

Grievances
